summary: Shows running klist.exe via win_command to confirm successful delegation (krbtgt server, forwarded flag); a failure shows the target server principal without forwarded.
questions: How do I run klist on a Windows host with Ansible to check delegation?
What does a successfully forwarded Kerberos ticket look like?

answer_card.title: Verifying delegation with klist
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible WINHOST -m ansible.windows.win_command -a C:/Windows/System32/klist.exe
```

Success: `Server: krbtgt/MY.DOMAIN.COM` and ticket flags include **`forwarded`**. Failure: no `forwarded` flag and the server is the target host's principal rather than `krbtgt`.
